name: Fillout
tagline: The core loop is small enough for a capable coding agent to produce a useful local version in one sitting. For Fillout, build a polished form that writes to a user-owned database and supports simple branching. The hard boundary is excellent airtable and notion integrations, scheduling, payments, and hosted polish, plus integrations, deliverability, and workflow depth.
